bible: FLAT 2D CARTOON STYLE: bold uniform black outline of constant weight (same thickness on every line, never tapering), flat color fill, two-tone shading only (base color plus one darker shade), no gradients, no airbrush, no 3D render, no glossy highlights, subtle paper grain texture over the whole frame. Warm desaturated palette: terracotta, mustard, dusty teal, warm grey. Setting: the sidewalk between two small clothing shops in a Colombian neighborhood, wet asphalt after rain, roll-up metal shutters, clothing racks and mannequins visible through the shop glass, overcast late-afternoon light. Vertical 9:16 composition.
negative_prompt: 3D render, Pixar style, photorealistic, gradients, airbrush, glossy highlights, variable line weight, text, captions, letters, watermark, logo, UI, extra fingers, deformed hands, style drift
